Designed and shipped a four-zone fare engine with runtime configuration validation.
Integrated GTFS data for 288 stops into six Prisma models with an idempotent seed pipeline.
Built real-time vehicle tracking using Redis, Socket.IO, and Leaflet.
Improved map and stop-search usability with keyboard navigation and ARIA accessibility.
